“(14) Except as provided for in paragraph (13) of

action  taken  or  proposed  to  be  taken  by  any
recognized  political  party  or  independent  group
against  a  member  thereof,  who  is  a  Member  of
Parliament, and accordingly no court shall have the
power to grant a writ, injunction, an enjoining order
or  any  other  relief,  preventing,  restraining  or
prohibiting any such action or proposed action.”.
